changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql:
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionAttribute') BEGIN IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FusionAttribute_Fusion' and object_name(parent_object_id) = 'FusionAttribute' and schema_name(schema_id) = 'dbo' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionAttribute] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_FusionAttribute_Fusion] END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FusionAttribute_FusionAttributeType' and object_name(parent_object_id) = 'FusionAttribute' and schema_name(schema_id) = 'dbo' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionAttribute] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_FusionAttribute_FusionAttributeType] END
exec sp_rename 'dbo.FusionAttribute', 'FusionAttribute_backup'; END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionAttribute_backup') BEGIN exec sp_rename 'dbo.FusionAttribute_backup', 'FusionAttribute'; END
